from build123d import *

# ---------------- Key dimensions (mm) ----------------
TOTAL_WIDTH   = 80.0                     # overall width  (X)
TOTAL_HEIGHT  = 68.6                     # overall height (Z)

FLANGE_THICK  = 11.4                     # bent flange thickness (X)
PLATE_WIDTH   = TOTAL_WIDTH - FLANGE_THICK   # 68.6 main plate width
PLATE_THICK   = 17.1                     # main plate thickness (Y)
FLANGE_DEPTH  = 62.9                     # flange reach behind front face (Y)
CORNER_RADIUS = 6.9                      # 2x R6.9 right-hand corners

SLOT_LEN      = 45.7                     # slot length (X)
SLOT_HEIGHT   = 5.7                      # slot height (Z)
SLOT_DEPTH    = 4.6                      # slot depth  (Y)
SLOT_X0       = FLANGE_THICK             # slots start at flange inner face (11.4)
SLOT_X1       = SLOT_X0 + SLOT_LEN       # 57.1

# slot / pocket vertical bands (bottoms) : 11.4-17.1, 22.9-28.6, 40-45.7, 51.4-57.1
SLOT_Z_BOTTOMS = [11.4, 22.9, 40.0, 51.4]

# flange pockets (detail A) - same heights, on the outer face of the flange
POCKET_DEPTH  = 4.6                      # depth into flange (X)
POCKET_Y0     = -PLATE_THICK             # start at back face of plate  (-17.1)
POCKET_Y1     = -(FLANGE_DEPTH - FLANGE_THICK)   # leave 11.4 rim at rear (-51.5)

# ---------------- Main plate ----------------
plate = Pos(FLANGE_THICK + PLATE_WIDTH / 2, -PLATE_THICK / 2, TOTAL_HEIGHT / 2) * \
        Box(PLATE_WIDTH, PLATE_THICK, TOTAL_HEIGHT)

# 2x R6.9 on the two right-hand vertical edges
right_edges = plate.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y).group_by(Axis.X)[-1]
plate = fillet(right_edges, CORNER_RADIUS)

# ---------------- Flange ----------------
flange = Pos(FLANGE_THICK / 2, -FLANGE_DEPTH / 2, TOTAL_HEIGHT / 2) * \
         Box(FLANGE_THICK, FLANGE_DEPTH, TOTAL_HEIGHT)

part = plate + flange

# ---------------- 4 slots (5.7 x 45.7 x 4.6 deep) ----------------
for z0 in SLOT_Z_BOTTOMS:
    slot = Pos(SLOT_X0 + SLOT_LEN / 2, -SLOT_DEPTH / 2, z0 + SLOT_HEIGHT / 2) * \
           Box(SLOT_LEN, SLOT_DEPTH, SLOT_HEIGHT)
    part -= slot

# ---------------- 4 pockets on flange outer face ----------------
pocket_len = POCKET_Y1 - POCKET_Y0
for z0 in SLOT_Z_BOTTOMS:
    pocket = Pos(POCKET_DEPTH / 2, (POCKET_Y0 + POCKET_Y1) / 2, z0 + SLOT_HEIGHT / 2) * \
             Box(POCKET_DEPTH, pocket_len, SLOT_HEIGHT)
    part -= pocket

# ---------------- Export ----------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
FALCON-663C  -  bracket reconstructed from the multi-view drawing.

Coordinate system:
    X  = width of the back plate
    Y  = depth (the arms project in +Y)
    Z  = height
"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions taken from the drawing (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
plate_w = 40.0        # back-plate width          (front view, bottom "40")
plate_t = 25.5        # back-plate thickness      (side view, "25.5")
plate_h = 72.7        # back-plate height         (front view, "72.7")

arm_len = 40.0        # arm projection from plate (side view, "40")
arm_w   = 7.3         # arm width                 (front view, "7.3")
arm_h   = 18.2        # arm height                (side view, "18.2")
arm_x   = plate_w - arm_w          # 32.7  -> the "32.7" dimension

web_t   = 7.3         # far-end web thickness     (front view, "7.3")
hole_d  = 3.6         # Ø3.6 hole through plate

# vertical positions of the three arms
z_top = plate_h - arm_h            # 54.5   (top arm flush with plate top)
z_mid = (plate_h - arm_h) / 2.0    # 27.25  (middle arm centred)
z_bot = 0.0                        # bottom arm flush with plate bottom

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
plate = Box(plate_w, plate_t, plate_h,
            align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))


def arm(z):
    """One forward-projecting arm, attached to the front face of the plate."""
    return Pos(arm_x, plate_t, z) * Box(arm_w, arm_len, arm_h,
                                        align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))


part = plate + arm(z_top) + arm(z_mid) + arm(z_bot)

# Web closing the opening between the two upper arms at their far ends
web_h = z_top - (z_mid + arm_h)                     # 9.05
web = Pos(arm_x, plate_t + arm_len - web_t, z_mid + arm_h) * \
      Box(arm_w, web_t, web_h,
          align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
part = part + web

# Ø3.6 hole through the back plate
part = part - Pos(plate_w / 2, plate_t / 2, plate_h / 2) * \
       Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_d / 2, plate_t + 2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
Reconstruction of the part from the drawing:
  - Rectangular block 80 x 44.4 x 44.4
  - 4x C4.4 chamfers on the vertical edges
  - Ø17.8 cylindrical boss on the top face
  - Ø17.8 bore through the block, coaxial with the boss
  - Boss / bore located 35.6 from the right end (80 overall)
"""
from build123d import *

# ---------------- key dimensions (from the drawing) ----------------
block_length  = 80.0     # overall length            (dim 80)
block_width   = 44.4     # width                     (dim 44.4)
block_height  = 44.4     # height (square section, from front view proportions)
edge_chamfer  = 4.4      # 4x C4.4 on the vertical edges
boss_dia      = 17.8     # Ø17.8 cylindrical boss
boss_height   = 17.8     # boss height
hole_dia      = 17.8     # Ø17.8 hole
boss_from_end = 35.6     # boss/bore centre from the right end (dim 35.6)

# X position of the boss/bore centre (block centred on the origin)
boss_x = block_length / 2 - boss_from_end

with BuildPart() as part:
    # ---- main block ----
    Box(block_length, block_width, block_height)

    # ---- 4x C4.4 chamfers on the vertical edges ----
    chamfer(part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), length=edge_chamfer)

    # ---- Ø17.8 cylindrical boss on the top face ----
    with Locations((boss_x, 0, block_height / 2)):
        Cylinder(boss_dia / 2, boss_height,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # ---- Ø17.8 bore up through the block, coaxial with the boss ----
    with Locations((boss_x, 0, -block_height / 2)):
        Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, block_height,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

export_step(part.part, "output.step")

"""
URSA-6868 - reconstructed from the multi-view drawing.

The part is a prism: the profile shown in the front view is extruded
through the 34.8 depth given by the top / side views.

Front-view profile (x-y plane, origin at the bottom-left corner):
    overall width  : 80
    overall height : 42.9
    2x R5.4        : bottom-left corner + concave corner of the step
    R2.7           : bottom-right corner
    R56.2          : large arc forming the right-hand side
    R6.7           : top-right corner round
    R16.1          : large arc on the upper-left
Extrusion depth    : 34.8
"""

from math import atan2, degrees, sqrt
from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. dimensions taken directly from the drawing
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
WIDTH  = 80.0      # overall width      (front view)
HEIGHT = 42.9      # overall height     (side view)
DEPTH  = 34.8      # extrusion depth    (top view)

R_TL = 16.1        # R16.1  upper-left arc
R_TR = 6.7         # R6.7   top-right corner round
R_RS = 56.2        # R56.2  right-hand side arc
R_BR = 2.7         # R2.7   bottom-right corner round
R_BL = 5.4         # 2x R5.4 (bottom-left corner + step fillet)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. profile layout (proportions scaled from the front view)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP_X = 15.4      # length of the horizontal step on the left
STEP_Y = 13.1      # height of that step
X_C6   = 69.0      # x of the R6.7 tangent point on the top face

# --- R6.7 corner round : tangent to the top face  y = HEIGHT ----------
c6 = (X_C6, HEIGHT - R_TR)                       # (69.0, 36.2)

# --- R56.2 side arc : centre solved so the arc reaches x = WIDTH ------
a56 = WIDTH - R_RS                               # 23.8
b56 = (HEIGHT - R_TR) - sqrt((R_RS - R_TR) ** 2 - (a56 - X_C6) ** 2)
c56 = (a56, b56)                                 # (23.8, 16.02)

# --- R2.7 corner round : tangent to the bottom face  y = 0 ------------
x_c2 = a56 + sqrt((R_RS - R_BR) ** 2 - (b56 - R_BR) ** 2)
c2 = (x_c2, R_BR)                                # (75.615, 2.7)

# --- R16.1 arc : tangent to the top face and to the vertical rise -----
c16 = (STEP_X + R_TL, HEIGHT - R_TL)             # (31.5, 26.8)

# --- tangency points on the right-hand side ---------------------------
def _tangent(c_large, r_large, c_small):
    """point of tangency between two internally tangent circles"""
    dx, dy = c_small[0] - c_large[0], c_small[1] - c_large[1]
    d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    return (c_large[0] + r_large * dx / d, c_large[1] + r_large * dy / d)

t_rs_tr = _tangent(c56, R_RS, c6)     # R56.2 <-> R6.7
t_rs_br = _tangent(c56, R_RS, c2)     # R56.2 <-> R2.7

def _ang(c, p):
    return degrees(atan2(p[1] - c[1], p[0] - c[0]))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. build the solid
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            # bottom edge
            Line((R_BL, 0.0), (x_c2, 0.0))

            # R2.7 bottom-right corner
            CenterArc(c2, R_BR, -90.0, _ang(c2, t_rs_br) + 90.0)

            # R56.2 right-hand side
            CenterArc(c56, R_RS,
                      _ang(c56, t_rs_br),
                      _ang(c56, t_rs_tr) - _ang(c56, t_rs_br))

            # R6.7 top-right corner
            CenterArc(c6, R_TR,
                      _ang(c6, t_rs_tr),
                      90.0 - _ang(c6, t_rs_tr))

            # top face
            Line((X_C6, HEIGHT), (c16[0], HEIGHT))

            # R16.1 upper-left arc (90 deg -> 180 deg)
            CenterArc(c16, R_TL, 90.0, 90.0)

            # vertical rise of the step
            Line((STEP_X, HEIGHT - R_TL), (STEP_X, STEP_Y))

            # horizontal step
            Line((STEP_X, STEP_Y), (0.0, STEP_Y))

            # left face
            Line((0.0, STEP_Y), (0.0, R_BL))

            # R5.4 bottom-left corner (180 deg -> 270 deg)
            CenterArc((R_BL, R_BL), R_BL, 180.0, 90.0)

        make_face()

        # second R5.4 : concave corner of the step
        step_corner = sk.vertices().filter_by(
            lambda v: abs(v.X - STEP_X) < 1e-6 and abs(v.Y - STEP_Y) < 1e-6)
        fillet(step_corner, radius=R_BL)

    extrude(amount=DEPTH)

export_step(part.part, "output.step")
print(f"Volume = {part.part.volume:.1f} mm^3")

import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions taken from drawing ORION-3896 (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Base plate
base_w = 80.0        # overall width          (front view  "80")
base_d = 60.0        # overall depth          (side view   "60")
base_t = 8.0         # base plate thickness   (side view   "8")

# Overall height
total_h = 32.0       #                        (side view   "32.0")

# Upright / clevis
clevis_x0 = 15.0     # left prong outer face
clevis_x1 = 65.0     # right prong outer face
clevis_d  = 20.0     # clevis thickness in Y  (side view   "20")
slot_x0   = 30.0     # slot left wall  (prong width 15 -> top view "15")
slot_x1   = 50.0     # slot right wall
slot_z0   = 24.0     # slot floor (8 deep)

# Rounded lug / tab
tab_x0 = 30.0
tab_x1 = 50.0
tab_y0 = 20.0        # lug starts at back face of clevis
lug_hole_d = 10.0    # "Ø10 THRU"
lug_hole_y = 45.0    #                        (side view "45")
lug_hole_z = 20.0    #                        (side view "20")
lug_r = base_d - lug_hole_y          # 15 -> round end reaches y = 60

# Base holes
base_hole_d   = 10.0 # "4x Ø10 THRU"
base_hole_off = 8.0  #                        (top view "8.0")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    # base plate -----------------------------------------------------
    Box(base_w, base_d, base_t, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

    # upright clevis -------------------------------------------------
    with Locations((clevis_x0, 0.0, base_t)):
        Box(clevis_x1 - clevis_x0, clevis_d, total_h - base_t,
            align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

    # U-slot ---------------------------------------------------------
    with Locations((slot_x0, -1.0, slot_z0)):
        Box(slot_x1 - slot_x0, clevis_d + 2.0, total_h - slot_z0 + 1.0,
            align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # rounded lug ----------------------------------------------------
    y_arc_base = lug_hole_y + math.sqrt(lug_r**2 - (lug_hole_z - base_t)**2)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(tab_x0)):
        with BuildLine():
            Line((tab_y0, base_t), (y_arc_base, base_t))
            ThreePointArc((y_arc_base, base_t),
                          (lug_hole_y + lug_r, lug_hole_z),
                          (y_arc_base, total_h))
            Line((y_arc_base, total_h), (tab_y0, total_h))
            Line((tab_y0, total_h), (tab_y0, base_t))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=tab_x1 - tab_x0)

    # lug hole (Ø10 through, axis parallel to X) ---------------------
    lug_hole = Cylinder(lug_hole_d / 2, (tab_x1 - tab_x0) + 4.0,
                        rotation=(0, 90, 0))
    add(Pos((tab_x0 + tab_x1) / 2, lug_hole_y, lug_hole_z) * lug_hole,
        mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # base holes (4x Ø10 through) ------------------------------------
    with Locations((base_hole_off, base_hole_off, 0.0),
                   (base_w - base_hole_off, base_hole_off, 0.0),
                   (base_hole_off, base_d - base_hole_off, 0.0),
                   (base_w - base_hole_off, base_d - base_hole_off, 0.0)):
        Cylinder(base_hole_d / 2, base_t + 2.0,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = bp.part

export_step(part, "output.step")

import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions taken from the drawing (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
TOTAL_LENGTH       = 80.0                     # overall length
SHANK_LENGTH       = 61.5                     # cylindrical shank length
HEAD_LENGTH        = TOTAL_LENGTH - SHANK_LENGTH   # 18.5 hex head length
HEX_ACROSS_FLATS   = 53.3                     # hex width across flats
HEX_ACROSS_CORNERS = 61.5                     # hex width across corners (= 53.3 / cos30)
SHANK_DIA          = 53.3                     # shank diameter
HOLE_DIA           = 34.8                     # central through hole

HEX_CIRCUMRADIUS = HEX_ACROSS_CORNERS / 2.0   # 30.75

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hexagon profile (vertex pointing up, matching the front view)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hex_pts = [
    (
        HEX_CIRCUMRADIUS * math.cos(math.radians(90 + 60 * i)),
        HEX_CIRCUMRADIUS * math.sin(math.radians(90 + 60 * i)),
    )
    for i in range(6)
]

with BuildPart() as part:
    # --- Hexagonal head (axis along +X) ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ):
        Polygon(*hex_pts, align=None)
    extrude(amount=HEAD_LENGTH)

    # --- Cylindrical shank ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(HEAD_LENGTH)):
        Circle(radius=SHANK_DIA / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=SHANK_LENGTH)

    # --- Central through hole ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ):
        Circle(radius=HOLE_DIA / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=TOTAL_LENGTH, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

export_step(part.part, "output.step")

"""
Fork-end pin / clevis pin reconstructed from drawing HELIOS-4437
(ISO 2768-m).  All dimensions in millimetres.
"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters taken directly from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
TIP_DIA     = 2.8     # Ø2.8  - small tip diameter
TIP_LEN     = 4.1     # 4.1   - tip length
SHAFT_DIA   = 8.3     # Ø8.3  - shaft diameter
SHAFT_LEN   = 63.4    # 63.4  - shaft length
HEAD_DIA    = 16.6    # Ø16.6 - head / fork outer diameter
OVERALL_LEN = 80.0    # 80    - overall length (side view)
HEAD_LEN    = OVERALL_LEN - TIP_LEN - SHAFT_LEN   # = 12.5
CHAMFER     = 0.3     # C0.3  - chamfer on the free tip end

# Fork slot (proportions taken from the pictorial / side views)
SLOT_WIDTH  = 5.0
SLOT_DEPTH  = 10.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Axial station positions (part built along +X, tip at x = 0)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
x_tip   = 0.0
x_shaft = x_tip + TIP_LEN
x_head  = x_shaft + SHAFT_LEN
x_end   = x_head + HEAD_LEN

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as pin:
    # --- small tip ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(x_tip)):
        Circle(TIP_DIA / 2)
    extrude(amount=TIP_LEN)

    # --- main shaft ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(x_shaft)):
        Circle(SHAFT_DIA / 2)
    extrude(amount=SHAFT_LEN)

    # --- head ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(x_head)):
        Circle(HEAD_DIA / 2)
    extrude(amount=HEAD_LEN)

    # --- fork slot cut from the free end of the head ---
    with Locations((x_end - SLOT_DEPTH, 0, 0)):
        Box(SLOT_DEPTH,
            SLOT_WIDTH,
            HEAD_DIA * 1.5,          # tall enough to cut right through
            align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER),
            mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- C0.3 chamfer on the free end of the tip ---
    tip_end_edge = pin.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).sort_by(Axis.X)[0]
    chamfer(tip_end_edge, length=CHAMFER)

part = pin.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
from math import sin, cos, radians, degrees, hypot

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions taken from the drawing (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
OVERALL_W = 80.0     # overall width  of the X (front view, horizontal)
OVERALL_H = 62.6     # overall height of the X (front view, vertical)
BAR_W     = 10.7     # bar cross-section width  (square section)
THICKNESS = 10.7     # bar cross-section thickness / part thickness (top view)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve for the bar angle so that the square-cut bar ends exactly
# reach the 80 x 62.6 overall envelope (centre of part at origin):
#   (H - w*cos(t))*cos(t) = (W - w*sin(t))*sin(t)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
def residual(a):
    return (OVERALL_H - BAR_W * cos(a)) * cos(a) - (OVERALL_W - BAR_W * sin(a)) * sin(a)

lo, hi = radians(5.0), radians(85.0)
for _ in range(200):
    mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    if residual(mid) > 0.0:
        lo = mid
    else:
        hi = mid
theta = 0.5 * (lo + hi)          # bar inclination (about 36.2 deg)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bar length: distance between the centres of the two end faces
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
half = BAR_W / 2.0
x1, y1 = half * sin(theta), OVERALL_H - half * cos(theta)   # upper-left end centre
x2, y2 = OVERALL_W - half * sin(theta), half * cos(theta)   # lower-right end centre
bar_len = hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the two crossing bars (square cut ends, crossing at centre)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
bar_a = Box(bar_len, BAR_W, THICKNESS)                       # upper-left -> lower-right
bar_a = Rotation(0, 0, -degrees(theta)) * bar_a

bar_b = Box(bar_len, BAR_W, THICKNESS)                       # upper-right -> lower-left
bar_b = Rotation(0, 0, degrees(theta)) * bar_b

part = bar_a + bar_b

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Verification / export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
bb = part.bounding_box()
print(f"bar angle      : {degrees(theta):.2f} deg")
print(f"bar length     : {bar_len:.2f} mm")
print(f"bounding box   : {bb.size.X:.2f} x {bb.size.Y:.2f} x {bb.size.Z:.2f} mm")
print(f"volume         : {part.volume:.1f} mm^3")

export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
IRIS-8007  –  iris diaphragm housing plate
Reconstructed from multi-view drawing (ISO 2768-m).

Features:
  * Ø80 disc, outer rim top at Z = 8.7
  * Ø58.2 pocket, floor at Z = 5.8 (blade pocket)
  * 8 x Ø10.9 thru holes, equally spaced on Ø43.6 bolt circle
  * central boss (Ø20 assumed from views) up to total height Z = 10.9
  * Ø3.6 blind hole, 7.3 deep from the boss top
  * 3 x C0.7 chamfers
"""
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters (mm) – taken directly from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_dia       = 80.0     # Ø80  main outside diameter
pocket_dia      = 58.2     # Ø58.2 blade pocket diameter
rim_height      = 8.7      # top of the outer rim
pocket_floor_z  = 5.8      # height of pocket floor above base
total_height    = 10.9     # overall height (top of central boss)
boss_dia        = 20.0     # central boss diameter (scaled from views)
center_hole_dia = 3.6      # Ø3.6 central bore
center_hole_dep = 7.3      # 7.3 deep (blind)
bc_dia          = 43.6     # Ø43.6 bolt circle
hole_dia        = 10.9     # 8 x Ø10.9 thru holes
n_holes         = 8
cham            = 0.7      # 3 x C0.7

outer_r  = outer_dia / 2
pocket_r = pocket_dia / 2
boss_r   = boss_dia / 2
hole_r   = hole_dia / 2
bc_r     = bc_dia / 2

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    # --- main disc (outer rim) ------------------------------------
    Cylinder(outer_r, rim_height,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # --- blade pocket Ø58.2, floor at 5.8 --------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, pocket_floor_z)):
        Cylinder(pocket_r, rim_height - pocket_floor_z,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- central boss up to 10.9 -----------------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, pocket_floor_z)):
        Cylinder(boss_r, total_height - pocket_floor_z,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                 mode=Mode.ADD)

    # --- 8 x Ø10.9 thru holes on Ø43.6 BC --------------------------
    with PolarLocations(bc_r, n_holes):
        Cylinder(hole_r, total_height,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- Ø3.6 x 7.3 deep central hole ------------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, total_height - center_hole_dep)):
        Cylinder(center_hole_dia / 2, center_hole_dep,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- 3 x C0.7 chamfers -----------------------------------------
    circ_edges = bp.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE)

    top_outer = circ_edges.filter_by(
        lambda e: abs(e.arc_center.Z - rim_height) < 1e-6
        and abs(e.radius - outer_r) < 1e-6)

HOLE_LOW_Z  = 8.0                      # lower Ø8 hole, from flat face

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            ThreePointArc((DISC_R, 0), (0, -DISC_R), (-DISC_R, 0))  # half disc
            Line((-DISC_R, 0), (-TAB_W / 2, 0))                     # flat face, left
            Line((-TAB_W / 2, 0), (-TAB_W / 2, TAB_LEN))            # tab side
            Line((-TAB_W / 2, TAB_LEN), (TAB_W / 2, TAB_LEN))       # tab end
            Line((TAB_W / 2, TAB_LEN), (TAB_W / 2, 0))              # tab side
            Line((TAB_W / 2, 0), (DISC_R, 0))                       # flat face, right
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=THK)

    with Locations((0, HOLE_LOW_Z, THK / 2), (0, HOLE_UP_Z, THK / 2)):
        Cylinder(radius=D_TAB_HOLE / 2, height=THK * 3, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    with Locations((0, 0, THK / 2)):

    top_bottom = [
        e for e in part.edges()

    ]
    profile_edges = [
        e for e in top_bottom
        if e.geom_type != GeomType.CIRCLE or e.radius > DISC_R / 2
    ]
    chamfer(profile_edges, length=CHAM)

"""
Reconstruction of drawing DELTA-2508 ("draftwright")
====================================================
Part: a curved strip (bow / leaf-spring segment).

Dimensions read from the drawing (mm):
    5.6        width of the strip
    80         overall height (vertical chord of the bow)
    11.0       overall depth of the bow (horizontal extent, side view)
    122.0 A/F  bend-radius call-out at the upper end
    121.7 A/F  bend-radius call-out at the lower end
    (strip thickness is not dimensioned -> assumed)

The bend is modelled as a circular arc whose chord is the 80 mm height
and whose sagitta is the 11 mm depth; the 122.0 / 121.7 A/F call-outs
describe the same bend (a single arc of this chord/sagitta has R ~ 78;
the call-outs are kept as reference parameters).
"""

import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# key dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
WIDTH  = 5.6       # 5.6   - strip width
HEIGHT = 80.0      # 80    - overall height of the part
DEPTH  = 11.0      # 11.0  - overall depth of the bow
R_TOP  = 122.0     # 122.0 A/F - bend radius called out at the top end
R_BOT  = 121.7     # 121.7 A/F - bend radius called out at the bottom end
THICK  = 1.5       # strip thickness (not dimensioned on the drawing, assumed)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# bend profile  (built in the XY plane: X = depth, Y = height)
# outer surface: circular arc through (0,0), (-DEPTH, HEIGHT/2), (0, HEIGHT)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
R  = (HEIGHT / 2) ** 2 / (2 * DEPTH) + DEPTH / 2     # arc radius  (~78.2)
cx = -DEPTH + R                                      # arc centre, x
cy = HEIGHT / 2                                      # arc centre, y

a_top = math.degrees(math.atan2(HEIGHT - cy, -cx))   # angle of top end
a_bot = 360.0 - a_top                                # angle of bottom end
span  = a_bot - a_top                                # arc sweep

outer = CenterArc((cx, cy), R, start_angle=a_top, arc_size=span)
inner = CenterArc((cx, cy), R - THICK, start_angle=a_bot, arc_size=-span)

outline = Wire([
    outer,
    Line(outer @ 1, inner @ 0),
    inner,
    Line(inner @ 1, outer @ 0),
])
profile = make_face(outline)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# extrude the profile to the strip width, centre it and stand it up
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
part = extrude(profile, WIDTH)
part = Pos(0, 0, -WIDTH / 2) * part          # centre the width on Y = 0
part = part.rotate(Axis.X, 90)               # height now runs along +Z

export_step(part, "output.step")

H       = 53.3     # overall height                       (Z)
D       = 29.6     # overall depth / lug width            (Y)

R_END   = 26.7     # R26.7 rounded end of the main plate
D_PIVOT = 13.3     # Ø13.3 pivot hole

"""
Tri-lobe flange  (URSA-6593)
- 3 lobes (90/210/330 deg) joined by 3 concave R40.4 valleys
- crowned (spherical) top, overall height 21.1
- hexagonal socket, 40.0 across flats
- central hole dia 22.4 through
"""
import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# dimensions taken directly from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
R_VALLEY   = 40.4      # 3 x R40.4  concave valley arcs
HEX_AF     = 40.0      # hexagon across flats
HOLE_D     = 22.4      # central through hole diameter
HEIGHT     = 21.1      # overall height
WIDTH      = 80.0      # overall width  (X)
DEPTH      = 73.1      # overall depth  (Y)
CROWN      = 2.5       # spherical crown sagitta (from front/side view)
POCKET_DEP = 10.0      # hexagonal pocket depth

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# derived tri-lobe geometry
#   lobes   : 90 / 210 / 330 deg
#   valleys : 30 / 150 / 270 deg   (R40.4, waist on the hexagon circle)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hex_R  = HEX_AF / math.sqrt(3.0)      # 23.094  hexagon circum-radius
D_val  = hex_R + R_VALLEY             # 63.494  valley arc centre radius
d_lobe = 29.28                        # lobe arc centre radius  (width = 80)
R_lobe = 14.643                       # lobe arc radius (tangent to valleys)


def pol(r, deg):
    a = math.radians(deg)
    return (r * math.cos(a), r * math.sin(a))


def tang(cl, cv, R):
    """point on circle(cl,R) in the direction of cv"""
    dx, dy = cv[0] - cl[0], cv[1] - cl[1]
    n = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    return (cl[0] + R * dx / n, cl[1] + R * dy / n)


L  = {a: pol(d_lobe, a) for a in (90, 210, 330)}   # lobe centres
Vc = {a: pol(D_val,  a) for a in (30, 150, 270)}   # valley centres

T = {(90, 30):   tang(L[90],  Vc[30],  R_lobe),
     (90, 150):  tang(L[90],  Vc[150], R_lobe),
     (330, 30):  tang(L[330], Vc[30],  R_lobe),
     (330, 270): tang(L[330], Vc[270], R_lobe),
     (210, 270): tang(L[210], Vc[270], R_lobe),
     (210, 150): tang(L[210], Vc[150], R_lobe)}

tip = {a: pol(d_lobe + R_lobe, a) for a in (90, 210, 330)}   # lobe crests
wst = {a: pol(D_val - R_VALLEY, a) for a in (30, 150, 270)}  # valley waists

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch():
        with BuildLine():
            ThreePointArc(T[(90, 150)],  tip[90],  T[(90, 30)])    # lobe 90
            ThreePointArc(T[(90, 30)],   wst[30],  T[(330, 30)])   # valley 30
            ThreePointArc(T[(330, 30)],  tip[330], T[(330, 270)])  # lobe 330
            ThreePointArc(T[(330, 270)], wst[270], T[(210, 270)])  # valley 270
            ThreePointArc(T[(210, 270)], tip[210], T[(210, 150)])  # lobe 210
            ThreePointArc(T[(210, 150)], wst[150], T[(90, 150)])   # valley 150
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=HEIGHT)

part = bp.part

# ---- crowned (spherical) top -------------------------------------
R_crown = ((d_lobe + R_lobe) ** 2 + CROWN ** 2) / (2.0 * CROWN)
part = part & Pos(0, 0, HEIGHT - R_crown) * Sphere(R_crown)

# ---- hexagonal socket --------------------------------------------
hex_pts  = [pol(hex_R - 0.02, a) for a in (30, 90, 150, 210, 270, 330)]
hex_face = make_face(Polyline(*hex_pts, close=True).edges())
part = part - Pos(0, 0, HEIGHT - POCKET_DEP) * extrude(hex_face, amount=HEIGHT)

# ---- central through hole ----------------------------------------
part = part - Pos(0, 0, -1.0) * Cylinder(HOLE_D / 2.0, HEIGHT + 2.0,
                                         align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
TITAN-2817 - three-tube mounting bracket
Reconstructed from the multi-view drawing (ISO 2768-m, scale 1:1).
"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
plate_w = 80.0        # mounting plate width            (X)
plate_h = 46.1        # mounting plate height           (Y)
plate_t = 6.0         # mounting plate thickness        (Z)

tube_axis_h = 27.8    # height of the tube axes above the plate bottom

# (axis X position, outer dia, bore dia, overall length from plate back face)
tubes = [
    (19.0, 16.4, 12.8, 30.0),   # left  tube
    (41.2, 17.2, 12.3, 40.0),   # middle tube
    (65.3, 17.0, 11.3, 60.0),   # right tube
]

support_len = 64.0    # overall length of the bottom support flange
flange_t    = 5.0     # thickness of the bottom support flange
rib_len     = 24.0    # reach of the triangular gusset
rib_top     = 19.3    # height of the gusset where it meets the tubes

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1 - mounting plate (back face on Z=0, front face on Z=plate_t)
part = Pos(plate_w / 2, plate_h / 2, plate_t / 2) * Box(plate_w, plate_h, plate_t)

# 2 - the three tubes
for x, od, bore, length in tubes:
    seg = length - plate_t
    part += Pos(x, tube_axis_h, plate_t + seg / 2) * Cylinder(od / 2, seg)

# 3 - bottom support flange + triangular gusset (full width)
profile = [
    (0.0, plate_t),          # (Y, Z) - bottom of plate front face
    (0.0, support_len),      # far end of the flange, bottom
    (flange_t, support_len), # far end of the flange, top
    (flange_t, rib_len),     # top of flange, start of the gusset
    (rib_top, plate_t),      # gusset tip against the underside of the tubes
]
part += extrude(Plane.YZ * Polygon(*profile, align=None), amount=plate_w)

# 4 - bores through the plate and the tubes
for x, od, bore, length in tubes:
    part -= Pos(x, tube_axis_h, length / 2) * Cylinder(bore / 2, length)

# 5 - fillets called out on the drawing: R1.6 where the tubes meet the plate
try:
    junction = [
        e for e in part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE)
        if abs(e.center().Z - plate_t) < 1e-6
        and any(abs(e.radius - od / 2) < 1e-6 for _, od, _, _ in tubes)
    ]

"""
TITAN-5128  -  curved "D" cover plate
Reconstructed from the three-view drawing:

    developed width   W = 57.5   (top view)
    height            H = 80.0   (front view)
    overall depth     D = 22.2   (side view)
    end radius        R = 40.0   (= H/2, semicircular end of the "D")
    plate thickness   t = 4.0    (from the edge views)

Flat pattern = 17.5 straight strip + R40 semicircle, rolled about a
vertical axis (straight left edge stays straight in the ISO view) so
that the finished part is 22.2 deep.
"""
import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- dimensions
W_FLAT = 57.5                  # developed width of the plate (arc length)
HEIGHT = 80.0                  # height of the part
DEPTH  = 22.2                  # overall depth of the rolled shell
R_END  = 40.0                  # radius of the semicircular end
THICK  = 4.0                   # plate thickness
STRIP  = W_FLAT - R_END        # 17.5 straight portion of the flat pattern

# ------------------------------------------------- bend radius (mid-surface)
def depth_of(r):
    """overall depth produced by rolling the plate on mid-surface radius r"""
    return (r + THICK / 2.0) * (1.0 - math.cos(W_FLAT / r))

lo, hi = 5.0, 5000.0
for _ in range(200):
    mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    if depth_of(mid) > DEPTH:
        lo = mid
    else:
        hi = mid
R_MID = 0.5 * (lo + hi)        # ~72.4
THETA = W_FLAT / R_MID         # wrap angle ~45.5 deg
R_OUT = R_MID + THICK / 2.0
R_IN  = R_MID - THICK / 2.0

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- the shell
def width_at(z):
    """developed width of the D outline at height z"""
    return STRIP + math.sqrt(max(R_END ** 2 - (z - HEIGHT / 2.0) ** 2, 0.0))

def cross_section(z):
    """planar annular-sector cross-section of the shell at height z"""
    a1 = -90.0 + math.degrees(width_at(z) / R_MID)
    pl = Plane(origin=(0.0, R_MID, z), x_dir=(1, 0, 0), z_dir=(0, 0, 1))
    outer = Edge.make_circle(R_OUT, pl, start_angle=-90.0, end_angle=a1)
    inner = Edge.make_circle(R_IN, pl, start_angle=a1, end_angle=-90.0,
                             angular_direction=AngularDirection.CLOCKWISE)
    e_end   = Edge.make_line(outer @ 1, inner @ 0)
    e_start = Edge.make_line(inner @ 1, outer @ 0)
    return Face(Wire([outer, e_end, inner, e_start]))

N = 48
sections = [cross_section(HEIGHT * i / N) for i in range(N + 1)]
part = loft(sections, ruled=True)

export_step(part, "output.step")

from math import cos, sin, radians

pin_length      = 56.0      # total pin length (48 + 8 from Detail A)
protrusion      = 48.0      # length of pin protruding from the disk face
bolt_circle_dia = 56.0      # bolt circle diameter (ø56 inferred)
num_pins        = 4         # four pins / holes

# Derived values
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
disk_radius        = disk_dia / 2.0
pin_radius         = pin_dia / 2.0
bolt_circle_radius = bolt_circle_dia / 2.0

# Build the disk (axis along Y, from Y=0 to Y=disk_thickness)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create a cylinder along Z, then rotate it to align with Y
disk = Cylinder(radius=disk_radius, height=disk_thickness)
disk = Rot(90, 0, 0) * disk
# The rotated cylinder is centered at Y=0; move it so its bottom face is at Y=0
disk = Pos(0, disk_thickness / 2.0, 0) * disk

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
pins = []
for i in range(num_pins):
    angle_deg = i * 90.0          # 0°, 90°, 180°, 270°
    angle_rad = radians(angle_deg)

    pin = Cylinder(radius=pin_radius, height=pin_length)

    center_y = (disk_thickness - protrusion) / 2.0

Reconstructed from the multi-view drawing (draftwright / L. ANDERSEN, ISO 2768-m).

Drawing call-outs used:

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
WIDTH      = 55.1                     # overall width of the part
LEG_LENGTH = 80.0                     # overall length of the horizontal leg
OVERALL_H  = 76.9                     # overall height of the part
INNER_H    = 65.0                     # clear height below the horizontal leg
THICKNESS  = OVERALL_H - INNER_H      # 11.9  plate thickness
R_OUTER    = 16.5                     # outer bend radius
R_INNER    = R_OUTER - THICKNESS      # 4.6   inner bend radius
R_EDGE     = 4.6                      # "15x R4.6" edge rounding

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# build the part
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as bracket:

    # ---- L-shaped cross section, drawn on the XZ plane ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as profile:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((0.0, 0.0), (0.0, OVERALL_H - R_OUTER))                     # outer face
            CenterArc((R_OUTER, OVERALL_H - R_OUTER), R_OUTER, 180.0, -90.0) # R16.5 bend
            Line((R_OUTER, OVERALL_H), (LEG_LENGTH, OVERALL_H))              # top face
            Line((LEG_LENGTH, OVERALL_H), (LEG_LENGTH, INNER_H))             # right end
            Line((LEG_LENGTH, INNER_H), (R_OUTER, INNER_H))                  # inner face
            CenterArc((R_OUTER, OVERALL_H - R_OUTER), R_INNER, 90.0, 90.0)   # R4.6 bend
            Line((THICKNESS, OVERALL_H - R_OUTER), (THICKNESS, 0.0))         # inner face

            if abs(c.Z) < 1e-6 or abs(c.X - LEG_LENGTH) < 1e-6:
                end_edges.append(e)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
HOLE_SPACING = 80.0      # 80.0  distance between the two hole centres
STRAP_W      = 12.0      # 12.0  width of the flat strap
END_R        = 16.0      # radius of rounded plate ends / bosses (Ø32)

HOLE_D       = 12.0      # 2x Ø12.0 THRU
SPOT_D       = 17.9      # Ø17.9 spot face
SPOT_DEPTH   = 0.3       # 0.3 deep
ARM_BOT      = 28.0      # 28.0  arm bottom above lower hole centre
ARM_TOP      = 52.0      # 52.0  arm top    above lower hole centre
ARM_W        = 40.0      # 40    arm width  (X)
ARM_DEPTH    = 43.8      # 43.8  arm length (Z, backwards)
CHAM         = 28.0      # C28.0 plan chamfer on the arm
FILLET_R     = 1.9       # 10x R1.9

# Plate : 12 wide strap with Ø32 rounded ends
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
profile = (
    Circle(END_R)
    + Pos(0, HOLE_SPACING) * Circle(END_R)
    + Pos(0, HOLE_SPACING / 2) * Rectangle(STRAP_W, HOLE_SPACING)
)

corner_verts = [
    v for v in profile.vertices()
    if abs(abs(v.X) - STRAP_W / 2) < 1e-3 and 1.0 < v.Y < HOLE_SPACING - 1.0
]
profile = fillet(corner_verts, FILLET_R)

plate = extrude(profile, PLATE_T)                 # front face at Z = PLATE_T

# Ø32 bosses on the front face around each hole
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    plate += Pos(0, yc, PLATE_T) * Cylinder(
        END_R, BOSS_H, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

x_out   = arm_x0 + ARM_W               # = 34
z_front = PLATE_T                      # flush with the plate front face
z_back  = PLATE_T - ARM_DEPTH          # = -31.8

)

    )
    part -= Pos(0, yc, PLATE_T + BOSS_H - SPOT_DEPTH) * Cylinder(
        SPOT_D / 2, SPOT_DEPTH + 1.0,
        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def _junction(e):
    bb = e.bounding_box()
    on_side = (abs(bb.min.X - STRAP_W / 2) < 0.1 and abs(bb.max.X - STRAP_W / 2) < 0.1) or \
              (abs(bb.min.X + STRAP_W / 2) < 0.1 and abs(bb.max.X + STRAP_W / 2) < 0.1)

    return a or b

    except Exception:

           align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    return shape.edges().filter_by(Plane.XY)

def _bottom_ring(shape):

              R_BOT_RIGHT)

the top / bottom faces and meet on the mid-plane.

import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- key dimensions (mm) ----------------
LENGTH    = 80.0    # overall length
WIDTH     = 16.0    # overall width
THICKNESS = 3.2     # plate thickness
END_R     = 5.6     # R5.6 - radius of the rounded left end
HOLE_DIA  = 12.2    # Ø12.2 THRU
HOLE_POS  = 56.0    # hole centre distance from the left end

# Geometry of the "bullet" nose: the two R5.6 arc centres sit at x = xc,
# z = -2.4 (top arc) and z = 5.6 (bottom arc); the nose tip is at x = 0.
xc = math.sqrt(END_R**2 - (END_R - THICKNESS / 2.0)**2)   # 3.92
zt = THICKNESS / 2.0                                       # 1.6 (mid-plane)


def arc_mid(cx, cz, r, p1, p2):
    """Mid-point of the shorter arc of radius r centred at (cx, cz)."""
    a1 = math.atan2(p1[1] - cz, p1[0] - cx)
    a2 = math.atan2(p2[1] - cz, p2[0] - cx)
    da = (a2 - a1) % (2.0 * math.pi)
    if da > math.pi:
        da -= 2.0 * math.pi
    am = a1 + da / 2.0
    return (cx + r * math.cos(am), cz + r * math.sin(am))

    # ---- side profile drawn on the XZ plane ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as profile:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline((xc, THICKNESS), (LENGTH, THICKNESS),
                     (LENGTH, 0.0), (xc, 0.0))
            # lower half of the rounded nose
            ThreePointArc((xc, 0.0),
                          arc_mid(xc, END_R, END_R, (xc, 0.0), (0.0, zt)),
                          (0.0, zt))
            # upper half of the rounded nose
            ThreePointArc((0.0, zt),
                          arc_mid(xc, THICKNESS - END_R, END_R,
                                  (0.0, zt), (xc, THICKNESS)),
                          (xc, THICKNESS))
        make_face()

    # ---- Ø12.2 through hole, 56.0 from the left end, on the centreline ----
    with Locations((HOLE_POS, 0.0, THICKNESS / 2.0)):
        Cylinder(radius=HOLE_DIA / 2.0,
                 height=THICKNESS * 3.0,
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

from math import sqrt
from build123d import (
    BuildPart, BuildSketch, BuildLine, Plane, Locations,
    Line, ThreePointArc, make_face, extrude, Circle, Mode, export_step,
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
overall_len = 80.0          # overall length                       (front view)
end_height  = 40.1          # height of the straight (right) end   (side view)
half_end    = end_height / 2.0   # 20.05 -> the "20.0" of the front view
thickness   = 7.5           # plate thickness                      (side view)
hole_dia    = 13.8          # Ø13.8 THRU
hole_ctr_x  = 9.9           # hole centre from the left extremity
boss_radius = 10.0          # 2x R10.0  (round end)
blend_r     = 0.5           # 2x R0.5   (blend of taper into the R10 arc)

# Round end / hole centre (concentric)
cx, cy = hole_ctr_x, 0.0

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tangent point of the upper taper line on the R10 round end.
# (This is the 8.5 dimension of the drawing:  tx ~= 8.49)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
px, py = overall_len, half_end          # top corner of the straight end
vx, vy = px - cx, py - cy
d2 = vx * vx + vy * vy
d  = sqrt(d2)
t  = sqrt(d2 - boss_radius ** 2)

tx = cx + (boss_radius ** 2 * vx - boss_radius * t * vy) / d2
ty = cy + (boss_radius ** 2 * vy + boss_radius * t * vx) / d2
# tx, ty = 8.495, 9.901  ->  matches the 8.5 dimension

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as link:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as profile:
        with BuildLine():
            # upper taper edge (tangent to the round end)
            Line((overall_len, half_end), (tx, ty))
            # round end, R10, through the left extremity (cx - R, 0)
            ThreePointArc((tx, ty), (cx - boss_radius, cy), (tx, -ty))
            # lower taper edge (tangent to the round end)
            Line((tx, -ty), (overall_len, -half_end))
            # straight (right) end, 40.1 tall
            Line((overall_len, -half_end), (overall_len, half_end))
        make_face()

        # Ø13.8 through hole, concentric with the round end
        with Locations((cx, cy)):
            Circle(hole_dia / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # into the R10 arc - the junction is already tangent, so no extra

    extrude(amount=thickness / 2, both=True)

"""
Clevis / fork-end bracket  (GEMINI-8401)
Reconstructed from the multi-view drawing (ISO 2768-m).

Coordinate system:
    X = part length   (0 .. 80)
    Y = part depth    (hole axis; part occupies -29.3 .. 0 after extrude on Plane.XZ)
    Z = part height   (0 .. 63.4)
"""
import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- parameters (from drawing) ----------------
L          = 80.0    # overall length
D          = 29.3    # overall depth (hole-axis direction)
H          = 63.4    # overall height
R_LOBE     = 11.7    # 2x R11.7 - rounded end of each fork prong
HOLE_D     = 15.6    # Ø15.6 cross hole through both prongs
LOBE_CX    = R_LOBE        # 11.7 -> lobe left edge at x = 0
LOBE_CZ    = H - R_LOBE    # 51.7 -> top edge tangent to rounded prong ends
SLOT_DEPTH = 21.5    # fork slot depth from left end (front view)
SLOT_WIDTH = 21.5    # fork slot width (Y, centered)
ARC_END_X  = 21.5    # concave cut-out meets bottom edge at x = 21.5

# ---------------- derived geometry ----------------
# Concave arc: tangent to bottom edge at (ARC_END_X, 0) and externally
# tangent to the lobe circle (center (LOBE_CX, LOBE_CZ), radius R_LOBE).
a = ARC_END_X - LOBE_CX
b = LOBE_CZ
R_ARC = (a*a + b*b - R_LOBE*R_LOBE) / (2.0*(b + R_LOBE))
ARC_CX, ARC_CZ = ARC_END_X, R_ARC

# Tangency point between concave arc and lobe circle
dx, dz = ARC_CX - LOBE_CX, ARC_CZ - LOBE_CZ
d  = math.hypot(dx, dz)
TX = LOBE_CX + R_LOBE*dx/d
TZ = LOBE_CZ + R_LOBE*dz/d

# Arc sweeps (both run clockwise around the profile)
ang_c0 = -90.0                                        # start of concave arc
ang_c1 = math.degrees(math.atan2(TZ-ARC_CZ, TX-ARC_CX))
sweep_c = ang_c1 - ang_c0
if sweep_c > 0:
    sweep_c -= 360.0

ang_l0 = math.degrees(math.atan2(TZ-LOBE_CZ, TX-LOBE_CX))   # start of lobe arc
ang_l1 = 90.0                                               # top of lobe
sweep_l = ang_l1 - ang_l0
if sweep_l > 0:
    sweep_l -= 360.0

# ---------------- build ----------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    # --- main profile (XZ plane) ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((LOBE_CX, H), (L, H))          # top edge
            Line((L, H), (L, 0.0))              # right edge
            Line((L, 0.0), (ARC_END_X, 0.0))    # bottom edge
            CenterArc((ARC_CX, ARC_CZ), R_ARC, ang_c0, sweep_c)     # concave cut-out
            CenterArc((LOBE_CX, LOBE_CZ), R_LOBE, ang_l0, sweep_l)  # rounded prong end

"""

Dimensions taken from the drawing:
    overall width  = 77.8 mm
    overall height = 80.0 mm
    thickness      = 35.6 mm

import math
from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# key dimensions (from the drawing)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
star_width  = 77.8          # overall width  of the star  (X)
star_height = 80.0          # overall height of the star  (Y)
thickness   = 35.6          # overall thickness           (Z)

inner_ratio = 0.382         # pentagram inner/outer radius ratio

# outer "radii" chosen so the star's bounding box matches the drawing
Rx = star_width  / (2.0 * math.sin(math.radians(72.0)))     # 40.90
Ry = star_height / (1.0 + math.cos(math.radians(36.0)))     # 44.22
rx = inner_ratio * Rx
ry = inner_ratio * Ry

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# star vertices (one point up, CCW)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
tips   = []                 # outer points
inners = []                 # concave vertices = inner pentagon corners
for i in range(5):
    a = math.radians(90.0 + 72.0 * i)          # tip angles
    tips.append((Rx * math.cos(a), Ry * math.sin(a)))
    b = math.radians(126.0 + 72.0 * i)         # inner vertex angles
    inners.append((rx * math.cos(b), ry * math.sin(b)))

star_pts = []
for i in range(5):
    star_pts.append(Vector(tips[i][0],   tips[i][1],   0.0))
    star_pts.append(Vector(inners[i][0], inners[i][1], 0.0))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# build the solid : flat star base, bevelled top -> pentagon plateau
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
base = make_face(Polyline(*star_pts, close=True).edges())
part = extrude(base, amount=thickness)

# cut each point with the plane through its two neighbouring pentagon
# vertices (at z = thickness) and its own tip (at z = 0)
for i in range(5):
    p1 = Vector(inners[(i - 1) % 5][0], inners[(i - 1) % 5][1], thickness)
    p2 = Vector(inners[i][0],           inners[i][1],           thickness)
    p3 = Vector(tips[i][0],             tips[i][1],             0.0)

    n = (p1 - p3).cross(p2 - p3).normalized()
    if n.dot(Vector(0.0, 0.0, thickness / 2.0) - p3) > 0.0:
        n = -n                                  # point away from the part

    part -= Plane(origin=p3, z_dir=n) * Box(
        400.0, 400.0, 400.0, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)
    )

Rectangular face-frame:
  * overall 80 wide x 60 tall
  * frame body 5 thick
  * bottom rail 7.5 tall x 15 deep (projects 10 forward)
  * left / right posts 17.5 wide
  * top rail 5 tall  ("5 HIGH")
  * stepped notch at each top corner: 8.8 wide, down to 52.5
"""

from build123d import *

# ---------------- key dimensions ----------------
W          = 80.0     # overall width
H          = 60.0     # overall height
T          = 5.0      # frame thickness (depth)

POST_W     = 17.5     # post width
TOP_RAIL_H = 5.0      # top rail height        ("5 HIGH")
BOT_RAIL_H = 7.5      # bottom rail height
BOT_RAIL_D = 15.0     # bottom rail depth

NOTCH_W    = 8.8      # corner notch width
NOTCH_BOT  = 52.5     # height of notch floor  (56.2 = intermediate step)

OPEN_W     = W - 2.0 * POST_W        # 45.0
OPEN_TOP   = H - TOP_RAIL_H          # 55.0

# ---------------- frame ring ----------------
frame = Box(W, H, T, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
frame -= Pos(POST_W, BOT_RAIL_H, -1.0) * Box(
    OPEN_W, OPEN_TOP - BOT_RAIL_H, T + 2.0,
    align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

bot_rail = Pos(0.0, 0.0, T) * Box(
    W, BOT_RAIL_H, BOT_RAIL_D,
    align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MAX))   # z = -10 ... +5

            align=(Align.MAX, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

part -= Pos(NOTCH_W, NOTCH_BOT, -5.0) * notch          # left  (x < 8.8)

"""
SIGMA-5624  link / rocker arm  (draftwright, O. Larsson, 1:1)
Reconstructed from the multi-view drawing:

  Big end  : two R15.5 lobes (stadium), hole centers 53.2 apart,
             2x Ø24.4 THRU
  Small end: Ø30.2 boss (30.2 A/F) with Ø11.1 THRU hole
  Overall  : 80.0 long, 7.7 thick
  Layout   : big-end left edge at x=0, big-end center at x=15.5 (=R15.5),
             small hole center at x = 80 - 15.1 (boss tangent to right edge),
             arm raised ~30 deg as shown in the front view
"""
import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- key dimensions (mm) ----------------
THICKNESS      = 7.7      # plate thickness (dimensioned 7.7 at both ends)
R_BIG          = 15.5     # big-end lobe radius               (R15.5)
BIG_HOLE_D     = 24.4     # big-end holes                     (2x Ø24.4 THRU)
HOLE_SPACING   = 53.2     # center distance between big holes (53.2)
BOSS_D         = 30.2     # small-end boss diameter           (30.2 A/F)
SMALL_HOLE_D   = 11.1     # small-end hole                    (Ø11.1)
OVERALL_LENGTH = 80.0     # overall length                    (80.0)
ARM_ANGLE      = 30.0     # arm elevation angle (from front view)

R_BOSS = BOSS_D / 2.0

# ---------------- feature centers (front-view layout) ----------------
c_low  = (R_BIG, 0.0)                       # lower big-end hole center
c_up   = (R_BIG, HOLE_SPACING)              # upper big-end hole center
c_small = (OVERALL_LENGTH - R_BOSS,         # small hole center: boss tangent
           HOLE_SPACING + (OVERALL_LENGTH - R_BOSS - R_BIG)
           * math.tan(math.radians(ARM_ANGLE)))

# ---------------- external tangent lines big lobe -> small boss ----------------
def external_tangent_quad(c1, r1, c2, r2):
    """4 corner points of the tapered arm (upper tangent pair, lower tangent pair)."""
    dx, dy = c2[0] - c1[0], c2[1] - c1[1]
    d = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    a = math.atan2(dy, dx)
    b = math.acos((r1 - r2) / d)
    p1u = (c1[0] + r1 * math.cos(a + b), c1[1] + r1 * math.sin(a + b))
    p2u = (c2[0] + r2 * math.cos(a + b), c2[1] + r2 * math.sin(a + b))
    p2l = (c2[0] + r2 * math.cos(a - b), c2[1] + r2 * math.sin(a - b))
    p1l = (c1[0] + r1 * math.cos(a - b), c1[1] + r1 * math.sin(a - b))
    return p1u, p2u, p2l, p1l

arm_quad = external_tangent_quad(c_up, R_BIG, c_small, R_BOSS)

# ---------------- build ----------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        # big end: stadium from the two R15.5 lobes (slot along the hole axis)
        with Locations(((c_low[0] + c_up[0]) / 2, (c_low[1] + c_up[1]) / 2)):
            SlotCenterToCenter(HOLE_SPACING, 2 * R_BIG, rotation=90)
        # small end boss
        with Locations(c_small):
            Circle(R_BOSS)
        # tapered arm (tangent to big lobe and small boss)
        Polygon(*arm_quad, align=None)
        # through holes
        with Locations(c_low, c_up):
            Circle(BIG_HOLE_D / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
        with Locations(c_small):
            Circle(SMALL_HOLE_D / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=THICKNESS)

export_step(part.part, "output.step")

Views (third angle):
    plan  view : S-shaped band, overall 80 x 29.5
    front view : 80 x 12.3   (plate thickness)
    side  view : 29.5 x 12.3

"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions taken directly from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
LENGTH    = 80.0     # overall length  (80)
WIDTH     = 29.5     # overall width   (29.5)
THICKNESS = 12.3     # plate thickness (12.3)

CHAMFER_TL = 12.3    # C12.3  upper-left corner of the plan outline
CHAMFER_BR = 6.2     # C6.2   lower-right corner of the plan outline

# The S-band is a constant-width strip; its two horizontal runs are
# offset by the plate thickness so the part measures 29.5 overall.
BAND_W = WIDTH - THICKNESS          # 17.2

Y_HI_TOP = WIDTH                    # 29.5  top edge of upper run
Y_HI_BOT = WIDTH - BAND_W           # 12.3  bottom edge of upper run
Y_LO_TOP = BAND_W                   # 17.2  top edge of lower run
Y_LO_BOT = 0.0                      #       bottom edge of lower run

X_S0 = 38.0          # start of the S transition
X_S1 = 58.0          # end of the S transition
D    = 7.0           # bezier handle length (tangent continuity)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            # left end face
            Line((0, Y_HI_BOT), (0, Y_HI_TOP - CHAMFER_TL))
            # C12.3 chamfer
            Line((0, Y_HI_TOP - CHAMFER_TL), (CHAMFER_TL, Y_HI_TOP))
            # upper run, top edge
            Line((CHAMFER_TL, Y_HI_TOP), (X_S0, Y_HI_TOP))
            # upper S transition
            Bezier((X_S0, Y_HI_TOP), (X_S0 + D, Y_HI_TOP),
                   (X_S1 - D, Y_LO_TOP), (X_S1, Y_LO_TOP))
            # lower run, top edge
            Line((X_S1, Y_LO_TOP), (LENGTH, Y_LO_TOP))
            # right end face
            Line((LENGTH, Y_LO_TOP), (LENGTH, CHAMFER_BR))
            # C6.2 chamfer
            Line((LENGTH, CHAMFER_BR), (LENGTH - CHAMFER_BR, Y_LO_BOT))
            # lower run, bottom edge
            Line((LENGTH - CHAMFER_BR, Y_LO_BOT), (X_S1, Y_LO_BOT))
            # lower S transition
            Bezier((X_S1, Y_LO_BOT), (X_S1 - D, Y_LO_BOT),
                   (X_S0 + D, Y_HI_BOT), (X_S0, Y_HI_BOT))
            # upper run, bottom edge
            Line((X_S0, Y_HI_BOT), (0, Y_HI_BOT))

TOTAL_H     = FLANGE_T + TUBE_H          # 60.0 mm overall height

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Rectangle(FLANGE_W, FLANGE_W)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(FLANGE_T)):
        Circle(TUBE_OD / 2)
    extrude(amount=TUBE_H)

    # ---- central through bore ------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(BORE_DIA / 2)
    extrude(amount=TOTAL_H, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- 4 corner holes on a 40 x 40 square pattern --------------------
    centres = [(sx * BOLT_PITCH / 2, sy * BOLT_PITCH / 2)
               for sx in (-1, 1) for sy in (-1, 1)]

    with Locations(*[(x, y, 0.0) for x, y in centres]):
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
            Circle(HOLE_DIA / 2)
        extrude(amount=FLANGE_T, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    def circles_at(edges, z, r, tol=1e-6):
        """Return circular edges whose centre lies at height z and radius r."""
        return [e for e in edges
                if e.geom_type == GeomType.CIRCLE
                and abs(e.arc_center.Z - z) < tol
                and abs(e.radius - r) < tol]

    sel = (circles_at(bp.edges(), TOTAL_H, TUBE_OD / 2) +

    sel2 = circles_at(bp.edges(), 0.0, HOLE_DIA / 2)
    chamfer(sel2, length=CHAM)

plate = fillet(plate.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), CORNER_R)

rim_out = Box(SQ, SQ, T_RIM, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

rim_out = chamfer(rim_out.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1], CHAM)      # 4x C1.1
rim_in  = Cylinder(CBORE_D / 2, T_RIM,
                   align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

part -= Pos(0, 0, -1.0) * Cylinder(HOLE_D / 2, T_TOTAL + 2.0,

               align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    slot = Rot(0, 0, ang) * slot
    slot = Pos(0, 0, T_PLATE - 1.0) * slot

#  projecting 24.5 forward from the back face)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
prof = Rectangle(SQ, SQ)
prof = fillet(prof.vertices(), CORNER_R)          # follow the flange outline
foot_bound = extrude(prof, FOOT_EXT)

foot  = Cylinder(FOOT_R, FOOT_EXT,

foot &= foot_bound

for sx in (-1.0, 1.0):

inner_solid = sweep(inner_rect, path=path)

"""
Rectangular enclosure base (open tray) reconstructed from the drawing.

Overall : 80.0 x 49.6 x 13.8
Walls   : 5.5 thick  -> cavity 69 x 38.6, corner radii R1.4
Outer   : 4x R4.1 corner radii
Holes   : 4x corner holes  Ø3.4 x 12.6 deep (from top) with Ø4.1 x 5.5 c'bore (from bottom)
          1x central hole  Ø16.5 THRU
Boss    : 8.3 x 13.8 x 4.8 high on the cavity floor
"""

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# key dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
L = 80.0              # overall length  (X)
W = 49.6              # overall width   (Y)
H = 13.8              # overall height  (Z)

WALL = 5.5            # side wall thickness  (74.5 = 80 - 5.5, 44.1 = 49.6 - 5.5)
POCKET_DEPTH = 12.6   # cavity depth from the top face
FLOOR_T = H - POCKET_DEPTH          # 1.2 floor thickness

R_OUT = 4.1           # 4x R4.1  outer corner radii
R_POCKET = 1.4        # 8x R1.4  cavity corner radii + cavity floor fillet

# corner screw holes
CH_X = 4.5            # hole centre from the side edge
CH_Y = 3.9            # hole centre from the end edge
CH_D = 3.4            # hole diameter
CH_DEPTH = 12.6       # hole depth from the top face
CB_D = 4.1            # counterbore diameter (from the bottom)
CB_DEPTH = 5.5        # counterbore depth

# central hole
BIG_D = 16.5          # Ø16.5 THRU
BIG_X = 53.8          # centre X (from left edge)
BIG_Y = 24.8          # centre Y (centre of part)

# internal boss
BOSS_X0 = 13.8        # boss left edge (from left edge)
BOSS_W = 8.3          # boss width  (X)
BOSS_Y0 = 17.9        # boss front edge (from front edge)
BOSS_L = 13.8         # boss length (Y)
BOSS_H = 4.8          # 4.8 HIGH

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# construction
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    # ---- outer shell with rounded corners -----------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        RectangleRounded(L, W, R_OUT)
    extrude(amount=H)

    # ---- cavity -------------------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(H)):
        RectangleRounded(L - 2 * WALL, W - 2 * WALL, R_POCKET)
    extrude(amount=-POCKET_DEPTH, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- round the cavity floor perimeter (R1.4) ----------------------
    floor_face = part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[1]      # cavity floor @ Z = 1.2
    fillet(floor_face.edges(), radius=R_POCKET)

    # ---- internal boss on the cavity floor ----------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(FLOOR_T)):
        with Locations((BOSS_X0 + BOSS_W / 2 - L / 2,
                        BOSS_Y0 + BOSS_L / 2 - W / 2)):
            Rectangle(BOSS_W, BOSS_L)
    extrude(amount=BOSS_H)

    # ---- 4x corner holes ----------------------------------------------
    hole_pts = [
        ( (L / 2 - CH_X),  (W / 2 - CH_Y)),
        (-(L / 2 - CH_X),  (W / 2 - CH_Y)),
        ( (L / 2 - CH_X), -(W / 2 - CH_Y)),
        (-(L / 2 - CH_X), -(W / 2 - CH_Y)),
    ]

    # Ø3.4 drilled 12.6 deep from the top face
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(H)):
        with Locations(*hole_pts):
            Circle(CH_D / 2)
    extrude(amount=-CH_DEPTH, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Ø4.1 counterbore 5.5 deep from the bottom face
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with Locations(*hole_pts):
            Circle(CB_D / 2)
    extrude(amount=CB_DEPTH, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- Ø16.5 central hole -------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with Locations((BIG_X - L / 2, BIG_Y - W / 2)):
            Circle(BIG_D / 2)
    extrude(amount=H, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part.part, "output.step")

"""
DELTA-8551 - "draftwright" grooved-head pin / needle
Reconstructed from the multi-view drawing (all dimensions in mm):

  overall length ................ 80.0
  shaft ......................... Ø1.6, with 4 longitudinal flutes R0.2
  head .......................... Ø9.5 x 9.5 long
  retaining groove .............. 0.6 wide x Ø7.9, 1.5 from the free end
  groove root ................... 2x R0.3  (full-round root)
  small end flange at the tip ... Ø2.2 x 0.8
"""

import math
from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# key dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
overall_length = 80.0      # overall length of the pin
shaft_dia      = 1.6       # shaft diameter
head_dia       = 9.5       # head diameter
head_length    = 9.5       # head length
groove_width   = 0.6       # retaining groove width
groove_dia     = 7.9       # retaining groove root diameter
end_rim        = 1.5       # material outboard of the groove (free end rim)
groove_fillet  = 0.3       # 2x R0.3 groove root fillets
flute_radius   = 0.2       # 4x R0.2 shaft flutes
n_flutes       = 4
tip_dia        = 2.2       # small flange at the free (tip) end
tip_length     = 0.8

r_shaft  = shaft_dia / 2.0
r_head   = head_dia / 2.0
r_groove = groove_dia / 2.0
r_tip    = tip_dia / 2.0

shaft_length = overall_length - head_length                 # 70.5
z_groove_lo  = overall_length - end_rim - groove_width       # 77.9
z_groove_hi  = overall_length - end_rim                      # 78.5
z_groove_mid = 0.5 * (z_groove_lo + z_groove_hi)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# body of revolution (profile drawn on the XZ plane, revolved about Z)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as pin:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (0.0, 0.0),
                (r_tip, 0.0),
                (r_tip, tip_length),
                (r_shaft, tip_length),
                (r_shaft, shaft_length),
                (r_head, shaft_length),
                (r_head, z_groove_lo),
                (r_groove + groove_fillet, z_groove_lo),
            )
            # full-round groove root : semicircle of R0.3 (2x R0.3)
            ThreePointArc(
                (r_groove + groove_fillet, z_groove_lo),
                (r_groove, z_groove_mid),
                (r_groove + groove_fillet, z_groove_hi),
            )
            Polyline(
                (r_groove + groove_fillet, z_groove_hi),
                (r_head, z_groove_hi),
                (r_head, overall_length),
                (0.0, overall_length),
                (0.0, 0.0),
            )
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # 4x R0.2 longitudinal flutes milled along the shaft
    with BuildPart(mode=Mode.SUBTRACT):
        for i in range(n_flutes):
            ang = math.radians(i * 360.0 / n_flutes)
            with Locations((r_shaft * math.cos(ang),
                            r_shaft * math.sin(ang),
                            tip_length)):
                Cylinder(
                    radius=flute_radius,
                    height=shaft_length - tip_length,
                    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                )

part = pin.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
VEGA-4406  --  cluster of 7 tubes (1 central + 6 on a bolt circle)
Reconstructed from the multi-view drawing.  All dimensions in mm.
"""

import math
from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions taken from the drawing
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
BC_RADIUS = 28.3          # bolt-circle radius of the 6 outer tubes
                          # (derived from 80.0 / 72.4 overall + 23.4 OD)
OUTER_ANGLES = [0.0, 60.0, 120.0, 180.0, 240.0, 300.0]

OUTER_OD   = 23.4         # OD of the six surrounding tubes
CENTRAL_OD = 38.1         # OD of the central tube

BORE_STD   = 18.1         # 5x 0 18.1 THRU  (0,120,180,240,300 deg)
BORE_SPEC  = 17.4         # 1x 0 17.4 THRU  (60 deg tube)
BORE_CENT  = 30.5         # 0 30.5 THRU     (central tube)

H_STD      = 24.4         # height of the five standard tubes
H_TALL     = 26.1         # height of the special tube + central tube

outer_r   = OUTER_OD / 2.0
central_r = CENTRAL_OD / 2.0

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outer solids : 6 surrounding tubes + 1 central tube
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
tubes = []
for a in OUTER_ANGLES:
    x = BC_RADIUS * math.cos(math.radians(a))
    y = BC_RADIUS * math.sin(math.radians(a))
    h = H_TALL if a == 60.0 else H_STD
    tubes.append(
        Pos(x, y, 0) * Cylinder(
            outer_r, h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)
        )
    )

tubes.append(
    Pos(0, 0, 0) * Cylinder(
        central_r, H_TALL, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)
    )
)

part = tubes[0]
for t in tubes[1:]:
    part = part + t

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Through bores
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
bores = []
for a in OUTER_ANGLES:
    x = BC_RADIUS * math.cos(math.radians(a))
    y = BC_RADIUS * math.sin(math.radians(a))
    d = BORE_SPEC if a == 60.0 else BORE_STD
    bores.append(
        Pos(x, y, -1.0) * Cylinder(
            d / 2.0, H_TALL + 2.0, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)
        )
    )

bores.append(
    Pos(0, 0, -1.0) * Cylinder(
        BORE_CENT / 2.0, H_TALL + 2.0, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)
    )
)

for b in bores:
    part = part - b

part = part.clean()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
Stacked-plate assembly reconstructed from the multi-view drawing.

  Front view : base 80.0 long x 12.9 high, plate stack bottoms at
               23.2 / 36.1 / 49.0, overall height 51.6
  Top view   : 80.0 plate, R5.2 corners, 74.8 x 20.6 pocket, 2.6 thick
  Side view  : base 27.1 wide, posts 13.6 x 10.3
"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Base block
base_length = 80.0
base_width  = 27.1
base_height = 12.9

# Stacked plates
plate_length        = 80.0
plate_width         = 27.1
plate_thickness     = 2.6          # "2.6 HIGH"
plate_corner_radius = 5.2          # 12x R5.2  (3 plates x 4 corners)

plate_bottoms   = [23.2, 36.1, 49.0]   # z of each plate's bottom face
overall_height  = 51.6                 # 12.9 + 3*(10.3 + 2.6)

# Pocket / recess in the top face of every plate
pocket_length        = 74.8
pocket_width         = 20.6
pocket_corner_radius = 1.3         # 16x R1.3
pocket_depth         = 1.3

# Corner posts that tie the stack together
post_length = 13.6                 # along X
post_width  = 10.3                 # along Y
post_x      = base_length / 2 - plate_corner_radius - post_length / 2   # = 28.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
solids = []

# --- base block -----------------------------------------------------
solids.append(Pos(0, 0, base_height / 2) * Box(base_length, base_width, base_height))

# --- plates with pockets --------------------------------------------
for zb in plate_bottoms:
    plate = Pos(0, 0, zb + plate_thickness / 2) * Box(plate_length, plate_width, plate_thickness)
    plate = fillet(plate.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), plate_corner_radius)

    cutter = Pos(0, 0, zb + plate_thickness - pocket_depth / 2 + 1.0) * \
             Box(pocket_length, pocket_width, pocket_depth + 2.0)
    cutter = fillet(cutter.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), pocket_corner_radius)

    solids.append(plate - cutter)

# --- connecting posts (2 per gap, at the plate ends) ----------------
spans = [(base_height,                       plate_bottoms[0]),
         (plate_bottoms[0] + plate_thickness, plate_bottoms[1]),
         (plate_bottoms[1] + plate_thickness, plate_bottoms[2])]

for z0, z1 in spans:
    height = (z1 - z0) + 2 * pocket_depth          # overlap into both parts
    zc     = (z0 + z1) / 2
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        solids.append(Pos(sx * post_x, 0, zc) * Box(post_length, post_width, height))

# --- fuse into one solid --------------------------------------------
part = solids[0]
for s in solids[1:]:
    part += s

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")
print(f"Part built: {len(part.solids())} solid(s), "
      f"height = {overall_height} mm, volume = {part.volume:.1f} mm^3")

"""
Plus / cross-shaped mounting plate
Reconstructed from drawing RAVEN-6821 (E. MARTINEZ, ISO 2768-m, scale 1:2)

Features
--------
* Plus shaped plate: 80 x 80 overall, arm width 40
* Thickness 20
* 4x R5 fillets on the concave (inner) corners
* 20x C5 chamfer running around the whole top perimeter
* Central blind hole, dia 12.1, 8 deep (from the top face)

# Parameters straight from the drawing (mm)

ARM_W     = 40.0     # width of each arm
THICKNESS = 20.0     # plate thickness
R_INNER   = 5.0      # 4x R5  - concave corner fillets
C_TOP     = 5.0      # 20x C5 - chamfer around the top perimeter
HOLE_DIA  = 12.1     # central hole diameter
HOLE_DEP  = 8.0      # central hole depth (blind)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Plus-shaped base solid  (union of two perpendicular bars)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
bar_h = Box(OVERALL, ARM_W, THICKNESS)    # horizontal bar  80 x 40 x 20
bar_v = Box(ARM_W, OVERALL, THICKNESS)    # vertical   bar  40 x 80 x 20
part = bar_h + bar_v

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) 4x R5 fillets on the concave vertical edges
#    (the four inner corners sit at (+/-20, +/-20))
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
inner_edges = [
    e
    for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    if abs(abs(e.center().X) - ARM_W / 2) < 1e-6
    and abs(abs(e.center().Y) - ARM_W / 2) < 1e-6
]
part = fillet(inner_edges, radius=R_INNER)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) C5 chamfer around the complete top perimeter
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
top_face = part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
part = chamfer(top_face.edges(), length=C_TOP)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Central blind hole  dia 12.1 x 8 deep, cut from the top face
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
hole = Cylinder(
    radius=HOLE_DIA / 2,
    height=HOLE_DEP,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MAX),   # grows downward
)
hole = Pos(0, 0, THICKNESS / 2) * hole               # top face at z = +10
part = part - hole

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sanity check + export
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
bb = part.bounding_box()
print(f"Bounding box : {bb.size.X:.2f} x {bb.size.Y:.2f} x {bb.size.Z:.2f} mm")
print(f"Volume       : {part.volume:.1f} mm^3")

"""
GEMINI-8110 plate - reconstructed from multi-view drawing
Two R23 lobes joined by tangent R23 waist arcs, base plate with
raised rim/ribs, pockets and central through hole.
All dimensions in mm.
"""
from build123d import *
from math import sqrt, atan2, degrees

# ---------------- primary dimensions ----------------
R_LOBE   = 23.0            # 6x R23.0 (lobe + waist arcs)
R_WAIST  = 23.0            # concave waist arcs, also R23
CL       = (23.0, 27.3)    # centre of left lobe
CR       = (57.0, 24.0)    # centre of right lobe (3.3 lower than left)
BASE_T   = 5.5             # base plate thickness
RIM_T    = 5.5             # raised rim / rib height above base
RIM_W    = 2.5             # rim wall width
TOTAL_T  = BASE_T + RIM_T  # 11.0 overall

D_HOLE   = 17.3            # central hole (THRU)
HOLE_C   = (40.0, 33.1)    # 33.1 above base, on the 40.0 line

D_POCK   = 20.0            # ø20.0 pocket in the left lobe
POCK_C   = (14.0, 32.0)

SLOT1_W, SLOT1_L, SLOT1_C = 6.7, 13.8, (27.5, 39.0)   # left lobe slot
SLOT2_W, SLOT2_L, SLOT2_C = 7.5, 13.8, (54.0, 14.0)   # right lobe slot
R_CORNER = 1.0             # 8x R1.0

# ------- waist arc centres (2*R from both lobe centres) -------
mx, my = (CL[0] + CR[0]) / 2.0, (CL[1] + CR[1]) / 2.0
dx, dy = CR[0] - CL[0], CR[1] - CL[1]
d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
ux, uy = dx / d, dy / d
h = sqrt((2.0 * R_WAIST) ** 2 - (d / 2.0) ** 2)
TC = (mx - uy * h, my + ux * h)      # upper concave arc centre
BC = (mx + uy * h, my - ux * h)      # lower concave arc centre

def _unit(a, b):
    vx, vy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
    n = sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy)
    return vx / n, vy / n

def _tangent(c1, c2, r):
    ux_, uy_ = _unit(c1, c2)
    return (c1[0] + r * ux_, c1[1] + r * uy_)

def _ang(c, p):
    return degrees(atan2(p[1] - c[1], p[0] - c[0]))

# tangent points lobe <-> waist arcs
T1 = _tangent(CL, TC, R_LOBE)      # left lobe / upper waist
T2 = _tangent(CL, BC, R_LOBE)      # left lobe / lower waist
T3 = _tangent(CR, BC, R_LOBE)      # right lobe / lower waist
T4 = _tangent(CR, TC, R_LOBE)      # right lobe / upper waist
